representative_file.name: PSI-10_Experimental table_Flame Design_Normal Flame.csv
representative_file.inspection_method: HTTP Range GET (0-16 KB) & openpyxl / csv parse
representative_file.classification_reason: Contains measured fuel and oxidizer mass flow rates, chamber pressure measurements, and derived adiabatic flame temperatures.

tad_semantics.theoretical_basis: Calculated using chemical equilibrium thermochemistry codes (such as NASA Glenn CEA / Gordon & McBride 1994, or Cantera) by solving constant-enthalpy, constant-pressure equilibrium for the specific fuel/oxidizer/diluent mixture at pmean and ambient reactant temperature. It is NOT a physical thermocouple measurement (thermocouple probes cannot survive inside the 2350 K reaction zone and were not present).

representative_file.inspection_method: HTTP Range GET (0-16 KB) & openpyxl / csv parse
representative_file.classification_reason: Mixed validation file combining theoretical predictions from multi-scale transport formulations with microgravity experimental drop-tower droplet extinction diameter observations.

mixed_content_semantics.model_portion: Columns 0-3 contain analytical/computational model extinction diameters (Dext_cool, Dext_hot) at pressures from 0.5 to 3.0 atm.
mixed_content_semantics.experimental_portion: Columns 5-7 contain empirical cool-flame droplet extinction diameter observations (Dext_cool_Expt) measured in microgravity drop tower tests at pressures from 0.5 to 1.25 atm.
